sentences.display: Juris Zarins argued that, in the classical and Arabic sources, Ubar was not a single town at all, but a region and a people: the Iobaritae, marked on the second-century map of Ptolemy.

sentences.display: Shisr, in this view, was one fortified station in that land, a vital source of water on the frankincense routes.
